title: Integrated Technician II Simulation Lab
level: Cultivation Technician II / advanced occupational pathway
intendedAudience: Learners who have completed or can demonstrate the Technician I prerequisite pathway
Cultivation technicians developing supervised troubleshooting, verification, reconciliation, and peer-support capability
prerequisites: THC Cultivation Technician I pathway or approved equivalent prerequisite evidence
evidencePolicy: Use canonical evidence-backed science and operational references for durable principles. Facility SOPs, labels, equipment manuals, validated sensor procedures, and jurisdiction-specific requirements control when more specific. Reused modules are development dependencies and do not substitute for course-specific occupational review.
assessmentPolicy: This owner-approved public academic course uses course-specific formative and summative/readiness evidence derived from material taught in the course. Academic course completion is educational evidence only and does not authorize professional credential issuance. Secure credential examinations, validated practical/capstone decisions, evaluator calibration, standard setting, privacy/security approval, and final credential release remain separately fail-closed.
description: Integrates the seven Technician II performance practicals and Senior Technician Diagnostic Shift capstone through supervised, evidence-based performance preparation. Readiness knowledge checks are formative only; completion requires each mapped practical and the capstone to independently meet its performance standard with no critical errors.
learningOutcomes: Prioritize competing Technician II deviations by immediate safety, containment, data-validity, crop or lot consequence, timing dependency and assigned authority before selecting a next action.
Integrate crop pattern, environmental context and measurement quality into a ranked diagnostic workup that separates verified observations, hypotheses and required next checks.
Verify sensor and equipment evidence before acting, classify safe operator checks versus authorized maintenance escalation, and reject major corrective action based on data known to be invalid.
Integrate approved fertigation execution, water and measurement verification, irrigation delivery, root-zone trend and crop context into a bounded troubleshooting recommendation.
Integrate IPM trend evidence with propagation and canopy performance while protecting biosecurity, treatment-authority limits, cultivar or stage context and uncertainty.
Investigate postharvest deviations by preserving product measurements, lot genealogy, affected-scope evidence, holds and product-disposition authority boundaries.
Reconcile traceability, planned-versus-actual records and KPI definitions while providing SOP-based peer support and a priority-ranked shift handoff without unauthorized record changes.
Assemble a reconstructable Senior Technician Diagnostic Shift evidence packet that supports evaluator scoring, remediation decisions and supervisor handoff without unresolved critical errors.
